ORDERED_WRONG_ITEM.summary: Customers mostly admit to ordering mistakes, chiefly ordering too many or duplicates, or a generic 'bought by mistake'. The most common specific mistake is the wrong connector for their phone or tablet (USB-C vs 3.5mm vs Lightning, iPhone model compatibility), followed by buyers who wanted wireless/Bluetooth or a feature these wired headphones lack (microphone, true noise cancelling, air-tube/EMF). About 5% are placeholders like 'NA'.

Many bought a replacement elsewhere in the meantime. A few mention lost or rerouted packages and orders they couldn't cancel.
